Enchanted versions sit in a different price bracket

Disney Lorcana's enchanted treatments are pulled at much lower rates than the standard versions of the same card, and the market prices them accordingly. Full-art borders and alternate framing make them visually distinct.

Card AI suggests matching records with the set and card number. Review the artwork and confirm the enchanted treatment or other finish before pricing the selected record.

Foil and non-foil are tracked apart

The foil and non-foil runs of a Lorcana card trade at different prices. Finish is stored per card, so your collection reflects which one you actually own instead of averaging the two.

A young game, but the same tracking problem

Lorcana sets have arrived quickly since launch, and collections built across them get disorganized fast. Bulk scanning lets you work through a stack in one session, and the collection keeps a running total that updates with the market.

Lorcana card scanner questions.

Can the scanner identify enchanted Lorcana cards?

The scan suggests catalog matches. Review the artwork and confirm the enchanted treatment or other finish before adding the card so it is stored and priced separately from the standard printing.

Does Card AI track foil Lorcana cards separately?

Yes. Finish is recorded per card, so foil and non-foil copies are stored as separate entries with their own values.

What is my Lorcana card worth?

Select the matching catalog record and confirm the treatment and finish. Card AI then shows the relevant current market price and available price history.

Is there a Lorcana card price checker as well as the scanner?

Yes. The Lorcana card price checker searches the same database the scanner uses, so you can check lorcana card value on a card you are considering. Adding cards gives you a lorcana collection tracker that updates with the market.
